newsitem.title: USA: Cytyc seeks FDA ok for pap test supplement.
newsitem.headline: Cytyc seeks FDA ok for pap test supplement.

text.p: BOXBOROUGH, Mass., Oct 4 (Reuter) Cytyc Corp said on Friday that it has applied to get clearance from U.S. Food and Drug Administration to market a supplement for its ThinPrep Pap test.

The supplement would allow women with inconclusive or borderline diagnoses of cancerous cells to be tested for the cancer-causing human papillovirus without returning to the doctor's office. It would do so by allowing doctors to use samples collected from their earlier visit, the company said.
The economic impact of the supplement is being evaluated in two independent clinical trials, the company said.
